# Defconst v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

> This library implements macros to define contants and enums that can be used in guards

## Pages

- [Defconst](https://defconst.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://defconst.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://defconst.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Defconst](https://defconst.hexdocs.pm/Defconst.md): Define constants and enum with use in guards
- [Defconst.Enum.DefaultGenerator](https://defconst.hexdocs.pm/Defconst.Enum.DefaultGenerator.md): Default implementation of enum generator
- [Defconst.Enum.Generator](https://defconst.hexdocs.pm/Defconst.Enum.Generator.md): Callbacks definition for generating enum values
